description: Keyword search (not semantic) over public posts, pages, listings, and market insights. Returns the best-matching pages with canonical URL, title, excerpt, and categories. Use it to find existing pages to cite or link to before writing new content. For a "is this topic already covered / what should I link to" judgement use sem.find_related; to browse the whole catalogue use sem.list_content.

query.description: Keywords to match against title and content.

name: sem.search_content
title: Search Semerenko public content
